rep.angle: lead with a recent hiring push you noticed
rep.name: Maya

rep_lines.text: Hi Priya, Maya with HyperSale. I noticed Meridian’s recent sales hiring push—can I take 30 seconds to explain why I called, then you decide?
We help new reps practise freight buyer calls with AI roleplays, while managers track progress through quote-backed scoring. How are you handling ramp today?
Got it. Where do ride-alongs fall short today—manager time, consistency, or reps getting enough practice before live calls?
Roughly how many hours a week are managers spending on ride-alongs, and what gets pushed aside as a result?
Fair question—I’m selling AI call practice, and I’m asking about manager time to see if it’s relevant. Can I ask two more questions?
Thanks. Roughly how many manager hours per week go into ride-alongs across the team?
That adds up. When managers lose those five hours, what tends to suffer most—coaching existing reps, forecasting, or something else?
That’s where HyperSale may help: reps practice independently, and managers review quote-backed scores instead of every ride-along. Worth a 20-minute look with your enablement lead?
Understood. I’ll send a brief note you can forward to your enablement lead, and we can take it from there. Thanks, Priya.

criteria.rationale: You established your identity, company, and a buyer-relevant trigger, then quickly explained the freight-specific use case. Lead directly with that relevance rather than asking for 30 seconds to explain it.
